LARGE_TRANSFER.name: Unusually Large Transfer
LARGE_TRANSFER.description: Transaction amount is substantially larger than the customer's typical discretionary spending.

NEW_PAYEE_BURST.name: New Payee Burst
NEW_PAYEE_BURST.description: Three or more transactions were made to a previously unseen payee within 60 minutes.

ODD_HOUR.name: Odd-Hour Activity
ODD_HOUR.description: Transaction occurred during the defined unusual activity window.

PATTERN_DEVIATION.name: Customer Pattern Deviation
PATTERN_DEVIATION.description: Transaction amount substantially differs from the customer's established spending pattern.
